**Finding: MINCOMMIT — compliant (preferred position); no redline proposed.**

- **No minimum or volume commitment on Corio.** Exhibit B prices BuySite Hosted Edition users as "Unlimited" (p0151); there is no committed user count, minimum guarantee, take-or-pay or shortfall penalty anywhere in Sections 4, 5, 11 or Exhibit B.
- **Fees are for ordered licences/services or actual usage.** One-time licence fee due on Software Acceptance (p0152, p0165); annual maintenance and MarketSite.net access fees for services actually provided (p0153–p0154, p0168), with maintenance continuing only "provided that Corio continues to pay" (p0055); revenue share is a percentage of Application Management Revenue actually invoiced (p0157); implementation on time and materials with a stated cap (p0161); additional services and training only at Corio's request and by mutual agreement (p0067–p0068).
- **Two items reviewed and deliberately not flagged:** the "minimum limitation of 40 Authorized Software Users per Customer" (p0158) is a condition for royalty-free use of the initial 3000 granted licences, not a purchase obligation or usage cap on us; and the audit clause "shortfall" (p0059) is a mutual true-up of under/overpayments — exactly the true-up treatment the playbook favours over a penalty.
